title: Clash Royale King Laugh
blurb: Clean, polished and entirely without mercy — this is the king's laugh as Supercell actually shipped it, rather than the deep-fried version the internet made afterwards. In game it arrives immediately after you have been beaten by a bridge-spam deck assembled by somebody with no interest in your feelings, which is why it provokes a genuine emotional response in millions of players. Play it post-victory for regulation-grade disrespect. Keep both versions loaded and escalate to the distorted one only when the situation truly warrants it.
origin: The king's laugh emote from Clash Royale, original quality.
